name: Paranormal
overview: Scripture clearly condemns involvement with the paranormal, including seeking out familiar spirits, wizards, and practitioners of divination, as shown in Leviticus and Deuteronomy. God commands His people to avoid these practices, warning that those who turn to them will face severe consequences, including being cut off from the community or even death. Isaiah emphasizes that the living should seek guidance from God rather than from the dead or spirits, and the New Testament example in Acts reveals that such spiritual activity is linked to demonic influence and exploitation. This teaching underscores the exclusive call to trust in God alone for wisdom and guidance.
